---
title: "Plotting individual SvDProper pilot data"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(purrr)
library(circular)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r load-subsets}
csv_path <- here("allTrials_YL.csv")
df <- read.csv(csv_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("Loaded", nrow(df), "rows from", csv_path, "\n")
```

```{r prep-factors}
# Session: 1,3,5,7 → Deterministic; 2,4,6,8 → Statistical
# Single x-axis: 20 conditions in order — Det low (5), Det high (5), Stat low (5), Stat high (5)
# Colors: red / purple (Deterministic low / high); green / blue (Statistical low / high);
#         five shades per block for the five set-size/cue levels.

item_cue_levels <- c("Set1", "Set2-NR", "Set2-R", "Set6-NR", "Set6-R")

df_plot <- df %>%
  mutate(
    NoiseType = factor(
      ifelse(Session %% 2 == 1L, "Deterministic", "Statistical"),
      levels = c("Deterministic", "Statistical")
    ),
    NoiseLevel = factor(NoiseLevel, levels = c("low", "high")),
    item_cue = factor(
      dplyr::case_when(
        ItemN == 1 ~ "Set1",
        TRUE ~ paste0("Set", ItemN, "-", CueType)
      ),
      levels = item_cue_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(ItemN != 1 | CueType == "NR")

shade5 <- function(light, dark) {
  grDevices::colorRampPalette(c(light, dark))(5)
}

cond_ax <- expand.grid(
  item_cue = item_cue_levels,
  NoiseLevel = c("low", "high"),
  NoiseType = c("Deterministic", "Statistical"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    item_cue = factor(item_cue, levels = item_cue_levels),
    NoiseLevel = factor(NoiseLevel, levels = c("low", "high")),
    NoiseType = factor(NoiseType, levels = c("Deterministic", "Statistical"))
  )

cond_ax$point_color <- c(
  shade5("#d68686", "#991b1b"),   # Deterministic · low — reds
  shade5("#b999dd", "#6b21a8"),   # Deterministic · high — purples
  shade5("#78b58f", "#14532d"),   # Statistical · low — greens
  shade5("#7f9de0", "#1e40af")   # Statistical · high — blues
)

# Unique levels for position; tick text = item_cue repeated (via scale_x_discrete labels)
cond_ax$plot_x <- factor(seq_len(nrow(cond_ax)), levels = seq_len(nrow(cond_ax)))

x_tick_labs <- rep(item_cue_levels, 4L)

block_section_ann <- tibble::tibble(
  x = c(1, 6, 11, 16),
  label = c("Deter/Low", "Deter/High", "Stat/Low", "Stat/High")
)

df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  left_join(
    cond_ax %>% dplyr::select(NoiseType, NoiseLevel, item_cue, plot_x, point_color),
    by = c("NoiseType", "NoiseLevel", "item_cue")
  )

# Circular SD of signed precision (degrees); input as radians for circular package
circ_sd_deg <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  rad <- x * pi / 180
  circ <- circular::circular(
    rad,
    type = "angles",
    units = "radians",
    template = "none",
    modulo = "2pi"
  )
  as.numeric(circular::sd.circular(circ)) * 180 / pi
}
```

```{r plot-precision, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
set.seed(42)

summ_prec <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(NoiseType, NoiseLevel, item_cue) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    x <- .x$Precision[is.finite(.x$Precision)]
    n <- length(x)
    if (n < 2L) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        cir_sd = NA_real_,
        cir_sd_lo = NA_real_,
        cir_sd_hi = NA_real_,
        n = n
      ))
    }
    est <- circ_sd_deg(x)
    bs <- replicate(800L, circ_sd_deg(sample(x, n, replace = TRUE)))
    tibble::tibble(
      cir_sd = est,
      cir_sd_lo = as.numeric(stats::quantile(bs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
      cir_sd_hi = as.numeric(stats::quantile(bs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
      n = n
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    cond_ax %>% dplyr::select(NoiseType, NoiseLevel, item_cue, plot_x, point_color),
    by = c("NoiseType", "NoiseLevel", "item_cue")
  )

y_top_prec <- max(summ_prec$cir_sd_hi, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(summ_prec) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(5.5, 10.5, 15.5),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.45,
    color = "gray45"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(x = plot_x, ymin = cir_sd_lo, ymax = cir_sd_hi, color = point_color),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = plot_x, y = cir_sd, color = point_color),
    shape = 18,
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = dplyr::mutate(block_section_ann, y = y_top_prec * 1),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.2,
    vjust = -3,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "gray20"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = x_tick_labs) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.14))) +
  labs(
    title = "Conditional Circular SD with 95% CI Error Bars",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Circular SD (degrees)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r plot-rt, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6}
summ_rt <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(NoiseType, NoiseLevel, item_cue) %>%
  summarise(
    med_rt = stats::median(ResponseTime, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    cond_ax %>% dplyr::select(NoiseType, NoiseLevel, item_cue, plot_x, point_color),
    by = c("NoiseType", "NoiseLevel", "item_cue")
  )

y_top_rt <- max(c(df_plot$ResponseTime, summ_rt$med_rt), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(5.5, 10.5, 15.5),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.45,
    color = "gray45"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = df_plot,
    aes(x = plot_x, y = ResponseTime, color = point_color),
    width = 0.11,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.22,
    size = 0.55,
    shape = 16
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = summ_rt,
    aes(x = plot_x, y = med_rt, color = point_color),
    shape = 18,
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = dplyr::mutate(block_section_ann, y = y_top_rt * 1),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0.2,
    vjust = -3,
    size = 3.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "gray20"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = x_tick_labs) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.14))) +
  labs(
    title = "Conditional RT (Median and Distribution)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "RT"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
